invariants.rationale: The result is either null or an instance of Actor, since the method returns an Actor.
Any invariant over only the listed parameters is not directly suggested by the method body, as all state is forwarded to the superclass.
If x is not in a positive region, result may be null due to hit detection logic in super.hit.
If y is not in a positive region, result may be null due to hit detection logic in super.hit.
If touchable is false, the expected behavior is often to return null in hit detection, but as the implementation is deferred, result may be null or non-null.
